server_strategy.official_falkordb: read-only schema discovery + parameterized bounded graph reads; never general writes
server_strategy.civicly: Python MCP server implementing custom tools through authorization-validating services

tools.name: find_related_incidents
tools.description: Find incident candidates by verified asset and chronological/spatial match; explain why each is related
tools.result_semantics: On non-SUCCESS status, return required envelope with null ID(s)/empty lists as applicable; include error; no claimed state change.

tools.name: trace_infrastructure_dependencies
tools.description: Follow bounded B05 directed drainage reachability, or explicit forward typed DRAINS_TO/UNDERLIES/COLLECTED_BY dependencies; preserve candidate qualifications
tools.result_semantics: On non-SUCCESS status, return required envelope with null ID(s)/empty lists as applicable; include error; no claimed state change.

tools.name: get_maintenance_history
tools.description: Read inspections, interventions and past failures of one asset
tools.result_semantics: B07-R: records[].evidence_ids comes only from that event's own validated asset/evidence proof paths, not the response-wide source_evidence_ids union. History remains contextual, not proof of repair resolution.

tools.name: retrieve_external_evidence
tools.description: Acquire real or synthetic external evidence, with explicit unavailable mode
tools.result_semantics: On non-SUCCESS status, return required envelope with null ID(s)/empty lists as applicable; include error; no claimed state change.

tools.name: retrieve_case_memory
tools.description: Find previous investigations and verified outcomes using graph links then semantic candidates
tools.result_semantics: On non-SUCCESS status, return required envelope with null ID(s)/empty lists as applicable; include error; no claimed state change.

tools.name: get_organizational_procedures
tools.result_semantics: On non-SUCCESS status, return required envelope with null ID(s)/empty lists as applicable; include error; no claimed state change.

tools.name: record_hypothesis_assessment
tools.description: Append evidence-grounded versioned assessment of a hypothesis
tools.result_semantics: On non-SUCCESS status, return required envelope with null ID(s)/empty lists as applicable; include error; no claimed state change.

tools.name: propose_inspection
tools.description: Draft inspection request for verification, not a claim it has happened
tools.result_semantics: On non-SUCCESS status, return required envelope with null ID(s)/empty lists as applicable; include error; no claimed state change.

tools.name: propose_resolution_plan
tools.description: Create typed draft DAG and validation report, not an authorized order
tools.result_semantics: On non-SUCCESS status, return required envelope with null ID(s)/empty lists as applicable; include error; no claimed state change.

tools.name: request_plan_approval
tools.description: Submit plan version and exact hash for human authorization
tools.result_semantics: On non-SUCCESS status, return required envelope with null ID(s)/empty lists as applicable; include error; no claimed state change.

tools.name: create_work_order
tools.description: Only execute a previously human-approved task through validated service
tools.result_semantics: On non-SUCCESS status, return required envelope with null ID(s)/empty lists as applicable; include error; no claimed state change.

tools.name: get_work_order_status
tools.description: Read latest work status and blockers
tools.result_semantics: B07-R: recorded status only. Until B12–B15 implement retrieval, blocking_task_ids/latest_status_event_ids empty placeholders are UNKNOWN, not verified empty relationships. Explicit data.gaps and PARTIAL for an existing visible WorkOrder; absent record UNAVAILABLE. No operational completion claim.

tools.name: record_intervention_outcome
tools.description: Record attributable operation result; does not directly mark problem resolved
tools.result_semantics: On non-SUCCESS status, return required envelope with null ID(s)/empty lists as applicable; include error; no claimed state change.

tools.name: get_pickup_execution_history
tools.description: Review actual vs scheduled waste collection for location or route
tools.result_semantics: B07-R: inclusive scheduled_at UTC window [as_of-days,as_of], node/relationship/source visibility before LIMIT; normalized time ASC, event ID ASC, relationship ID ASC;100 rows plus one lookahead, additional graph export caps. truncated means omitted eligible rows/context, never verified absence. Source schedule-clock warnings retained.

tools.name: get_road_condition_history
tools.description: Retrieve evidence-linked chronological road conditions and repair attempts
tools.result_semantics: B07-R: inclusive observed_at UTC window [as_of-days,as_of], node/relationship/source visibility before LIMIT; normalized time ASC, event ID ASC, relationship ID ASC;100 rows plus one lookahead, additional graph export caps. truncated means omitted eligible rows/context, never verified absence.

tools.name: get_source_document_excerpt
tools.description: Read cited versioned municipal procedure passage by document ID
tools.result_semantics: Never infer success from missing source; unavailable returns status UNAVAILABLE and empty data.

tools.name: get_monitoring_status
tools.description: Return condition-specific monitoring and verification status
tools.result_semantics: Never infer success from missing source; unavailable returns status UNAVAILABLE and empty data.

tools.name: get_decision_evidence_path
tools.description: Return bounded FalkorDB justification graph path for a decision
tools.result_semantics: Never infer success from missing source; unavailable returns status UNAVAILABLE and empty data.
